verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Zero Data Retention policy for Growth+ tiers (API data auto-deleted within 24 hours) and SOC2/HIPAA compliance, and offers VPC/on-prem deployment options that keep data within customer control — all of which support preventing data use for training. However, no evidence explicitly states a commitment not to train models on customer data, ZDR is gated behind paid tiers (not default/free), and a community comment notes DPAs (often tied to no-training commitments) are also enterprise-only. Missing for 10: explicit no-training-on-customer-data clause, ZDR/DPA availability for lower/free tiers, independent audit confirming policy adherence.
